mechanism_narrative: The current level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is positively correlated with S&P 500 20-day forward returns. A lower FEDFUNDS level is associated with higher expected returns, and the signal is always active without any threshold condition.
failure_condition: The Rank IC of FEDFUNDS level on 20-day forward returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) falls below 1.5% in the current month, it signals an easing monetary policy that compresses discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 1.5%, the 20-day forward returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 1.5%) and a declining unemployment rate (UNRATE change < -0.2% over 3 months) signals a strong economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 1.5% AND UNRATE change < -0.2% over 3 months
failure_condition: The interaction signal (FEDFUNDS < 1.5% AND UNRATE change < -0.2%) produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of strong housing market demand (HOUST > 1200 thousand units), the S&P 500 exhibits positive forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the housing sector's health signals broader economic strength.
failure_condition: When HOUST > 1200, the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) of more than 0.3 percentage points over the past 3 months signals a tightening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In more than 50% of instances where UNRATE change < -0.3% over 3 months, the 5-day forward returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong industrial production (INDPRO > 105) and high housing starts (HOUST > 1100) signals robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction signal (INDPRO > 105 AND HOUST > 1100) produces negative 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained annual inflation rate below 1.5% (as measured by CPIAUCSL) signals a deflationary environment that prompts central bank easing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL annual rate < 1.5%, the 60-day forward returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of strong GDP growth (GDPC1 QoQ growth > 1.0%), the S&P 500 exhibits positive forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the economy expands and corporate earnings rise.
failure_condition: When GDPC1 QoQ growth > 1.0%, the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.
